guidance_fy26.src: Q2-26 shareholder letter, 8-K Item 2.02 Ex. 99.1 filed 16-Jul-2026: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1065280/000106528026000211/ex991_q226.htm
guidance_fy26.revenue_note: FY26 revenue $51.0-51.4bn (13-14% growth, ~12% F/X neutral), narrowed from $50.7-51.7bn (Q4-25 letter 20-Jan-2026; unchanged in the Q1-26 letter 16-Apr-2026)
guidance_fy26.op_margin_note: FY26 operating margin 31.5% on a reported basis and at F/X rates of 1-Jan-2026 (unchanged since the Q4-25 letter); implies 20%+ operating income growth
guidance_fy26.content_amort_note: Content amortization to grow ~10% in 2026, faster in the first half (Q4-25, Q1-26 and Q2-26 letters)
guidance_fy26.fcf_note: FCF ~$12.5bn (raised from ~$11bn in the Q1-26 letter; reiterated 16-Jul-2026); includes the $2.8bn WBD termination fee, cash taxes on it and an expected ~$700m Brazil tax deposit (Q4-25 letter)
guidance_fy26.cash_content_note: Annual cash content spend to content amortization ratio ~1.1x (Q4-25, Q1-26, Q2-26 letters)
guidance_fy26.ads_note: Ads revenue to roughly double to ~$3bn in 2026 (Q2-26 letter)

q3.note: Q3-26 forecast (Q2-26 letter summary table): revenue $12,860m (+11.7% y/y; +11% F/X neutral), operating income $4,268m, operating margin 33.2%, net income $3,452m, diluted EPS $0.82

debt.at_2026_06_30: Senior notes $14,309m carrying ($14,372m par less $49m issuance costs / discount, plus $14m fair-value hedge adjustment); EUR 4,700m of the notes are remeasured each quarter. $3bn revolving credit facility (Apr-2024, matures Apr-2029) undrawn.
debt.new_notes: $1,000m 5.250% senior notes due 2036 issued 22-Jul-2026 (8-K 22-Jul-2026); the Q2-26 letter says the $1bn of notes maturing later in 2026 will be refinanced.
debt.coupon_note: Par-weighted coupon of the 30-Jun-2026 notes 4.76% (EUR notes 3.625-4.625%, USD notes 4.375-6.375%); Q2-26 interest expense $175.7m (~4.9% annualised on $14.4bn).

capital_return.buyback: Board authorised an additional $25bn in April 2026 on top of the $6.8bn left at the end of Q1; $4.7bn repurchased in Q2-26; $27.1bn of authorization remaining (Q2-26 letter). No dividend.
capital_return.policy: Capital allocation: reinvest in the business (organic and selective M&A), maintain a healthy balance sheet and liquidity, return excess cash via buybacks. The Q1-24 letter (8-K 18-Apr-2024) dropped the former anchors ($10-15bn gross debt; minimum cash equal to two months of revenue) for 'financial policies consistent with a solid investment grade credit rating'.

deals.wbd: WBD transaction: definitive agreement 4-Dec-2025 (8-K 5-Dec-2025) to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery's streaming and studios businesses, amended 19-Jan-2026 (8-K 20-Jan-2026); terminated by WBD on 27-Feb-2026 (8-K Item 1.02) to merge with Paramount Skydance, which paid Netflix a $2.8bn termination fee, recorded in interest and other income (expense) in Q1-26 (Q2-26 10-Q Note 6). Bridge / term-loan commitments for the deal (8-K 22-Dec-2025) lapsed with the termination.
deals.acq_2026: March 2026: business combination for ~$587m cash (Q2-26 10-Q Note 6; purchase-price allocation not disclosed; $585.7m in the cash-flow statement).
deals.acq_hist: Earlier acquisitions (2021-2023 cash-flow line 'Acquisitions'): animation, VFX and games studios; no revenue contribution disclosed.

restructuring_q222.src: Q2-22 letter (8-K 19-Jul-2022): 'approximately $70 million of severance costs and an $80m non-cash impairment of certain real estate leases'; Q3-22 letter: 'excluding the $150m of restructuring costs in Q2'.

brazil_q325.src: Q3-25 letter (8-K 21-Oct-2025): 'an expense in Q3'25 of approximately $619 million related to an ongoing dispute with Brazilian tax authorities regarding certain non-income tax assessments' (in cost of revenues); operating margin 28% vs 31.5% guidance.

wbd_fee_q126.src: Q2-26 10-Q Note 6: $2.8bn termination fee received in Q1-26, recorded in interest and other income (expense).

price.src: Share price $70.00 provided by the user (13-Oct-2026); update to market.
